scope: Native direct AutoRest ConfigAPI public flag projection with shared native context/auth/transport/control mappings. Full-document Get is a separately documented enhancement; Set and tenant/live qualification are not promoted.

source_review.errors: Retained response and typed failure for 403, unsupported statuses, malformed/non-object roots; cancellation prevents credential acquisition. A false value with an error is not a disabled-setting success.

source_review.native_enhancements: Strict complete-document Get, service camelCase branding/appSettingsList/raw fields and typed errors remain separate from the public projection; no automatic document mutation.

execution.examples: Compiled only; no example invokes a workflow during go test.
